text.tspan: any gate fails: its exact output goes back to the agent
The Verify Loop: Let the Toolchain Say When It Is Done
Every failure is precise, machine-readable feedback the agent can act on; only all-green work reaches a human
Gates, cheapest first: each one that passes hands on to the next; the first red one stops the run
PostToolUse hook: dotnet format after each edit
PreToolUse guard: existing tests stay read-only
CI: the same gates run again on the pull request
fix the code, not the test
